warnings: PNG contains two portrait sheets rotated 90 degrees within one landscape scan; programmatically cropped to left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. This file is the physical LEFT half (the higher-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 2/21), paired with แผ่นที่ 1/21 (สรุปงาน, RIGHT half) extracted as _1.json.

หมวดงานโครงสร้าง (structural work category) does not close with a 'รวมข้อ 1' subtotal row on this sheet -- it continues onto บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_07_หน้า79_1_structural_boq.json (แผ่นที่ 3/21, items 1.10-1.12) before the category total appears.

Items 1.1-1.9 each carry a distinct number in the ลำดับที่ column, separate from the รายการ description text -- confirmed at high zoom. Rows 1.8's two diameter lines (dia.6/dia.9) and the SD40 dia.12/dia.16 pair are printed as a single item's continuation (no ลำดับที่ of their own, no leading dash) rather than as bulleted sub-items; recorded as separate items per spec §11 rather than merged into the row above.
'ค่าแรงแบบหล่อคอนกรีต', 'ค้ำยันแบบหล่อคอนกรีต' and 'เสาค้ำ' are unnumbered rows nested under 1.6 (แบบหล่อคอนกรีต) with no leading dash in the source -- recorded as their own items per spec §11.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row on this sheet -- transcribed as null, not invented.
All quantities re-verified at 3x zoom after rotating a programmatic crop of the left half (141, 40, 4, 3, 43, 316, 452, 95, 146, 113, 708, 2184, 509, 2599, 180).
